rounds.restatement: The headless core must report every template error, at parse time or at runtime, as a TemplateError with a diagnostic code (syntax-error, missing-variable, unknown-filter, type-error, limit-*) and the 1-based line and column of the node that failed, never a 1:1 placeholder. It must also bound the work with configurable limits: total FOR iterations, output length and block nesting depth. The defaults are 10000 / 1000000 / 32 and are exported as DEFAULT_LIMITS, and a partial limits option keeps the remaining defaults. The work must not change what a passing template renders, must not add runtime dependencies, and must not bring n8n or I/O into core. This is the engine surface that the structured render result, the API and the CLI will report from.
rounds.brief_mismatch: m1 (do not change what any currently passing template renders) cannot fully hold alongside c6's mandated defaults. A template that renders today with more than 10000 total FOR iterations, more than 1000000 output characters or nesting deeper than 32 will throw once this change lands, including through the n8n node, which uses the default limits. The criteria only promise 'a template under every limit renders as before', so m1 should be read as limited to templates under every default limit. The lead should confirm that reading.

findings.title: A very long ELSEIF chain still overflows the stack with an uncoded RangeError instead of a located diagnostic

serves.scenario: 'errors carry code, line and column everywhere': ELSEIF is parsed and interpreted as recursive nested IfNodes that the depth counter does not count. A chain of about 20000 ELSEIFs (a template of about 260 KB) throws 'RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded' with no code, line or column. This was already true at base and is not a block-nesting case under c5, so it is noted rather than raised as a fix request.

findings.rubric: each criterion is met by the diff and its test
findings.reproduction: Call resolveTemplate('{{IF t}}a' + '{{ELSEIF t}}b'.repeat(20000) + '{{END_IF}}', new Map([['t','x']]), {strictMode:true}): it throws RangeError with undefined code, line and column. With 5000 it renders.
findings.label: f3

rulings.note: pre-existing stack overflow on very long ELSEIF chains, not part of the criteria
